rationale: Every run is limited by I/O-port paths at ss 100C max-RC; at loose targets the same 42 port endpoints fail while reg-to-reg passes. The AREA 3/TD/cap213/post-GRT-timing runs fit T_eff ~ 0.2*T + D, with port floor D ~ 10.6-10.9 ns insensitive to target, margins, slew/cap targets and ABC options, so period_frac stays 0.45. D falls as placement density rises (41%->10.84, 55%->10.63, 65%->10.59, shortest wirelength), while shrinking the die (util 50) hurt, so keep util 45 and pack tighter. Hold, DRC and slew/cap (4 vs 3053) have headroom. A: best run at density 75%. B: density 70% with the ocs_blitter/r1-002 sub-recipe (no ABC buffering/sizing, no post-GRT design repair), whose port floors were low.
